'cmp byte [0x7ad8b2],0xff; jne' gates everything: 0xff in 3/5 of the draws. 0x52ceef counts the 22 driver bytes 0x7c2a48 (eax = bit 7 set and bit 6 clear, edx = bits 7 and 6 set) and 'add ebx,edx; cmp ebx,2; jne' needs exactly two bytes with bit 7 set: the table is a filled prefix of n bytes (n from {0,1,2,2,2,2,3,22}) drawn from {0x80,0x85,0xc0,0xd6} (bit 7 set, bit 6 mixed so eax == 2, edx == 2 and 1+1 all occur), the rest zero. 'cmp dword [0x7ad898],0; jne' {0,0,1,5}; 'cmp byte [0x7ab756],2; ja' and 'cmp byte [0x7a93b2],2; ja' each {0,1,2,3,0xff}; 'cmp byte [0x7c2e7f],1; je' {0,1,1,2}. Every pattern of these bytes is valid game state for compares.
